name: Close the loop — levers, attest, report, evidence

meta.why: The score-then-gate example stops at the decision. This one is the half that was unreachable until the node covered all fifteen operations: obtaining a lever_token, attesting that you acted on it, reporting what actually happened, and asking whether acting worked. Every step here is FREE — only Rank costs a run.
read_first: https://hunter-seeker.io/docs/control-arm — why a random holdout is what makes the evidence mean anything
https://hunter-seeker.io/docs/two-loops — this workflow is Loop B
meta.expect: Action evidence returns live: null until each cell has 30 reported outcomes, and flags small_n below 100. That is the floor working, not a failure — report it as 'not enough evidence yet', never as 'no effect'.

nodes.name: Rank (ONE RUN)
nodes.notes: The only billable step, and it is refunded on an honest-empty. Everything downstream reuses ranking_ref for an hour, free.

nodes.name: Cleared?
nodes.notes: An honest-empty is a SUCCESSFUL terminal result and the run was refunded. Do not retry it — identical inputs return an identical envelope. Record the negative finding and stop for this cycle.

nodes.name: Log the refusal
nodes.notes: run.honest_empty — negative knowledge. Relay {{$json.reasons}} to whoever asked; improving the input is the only productive next step.

nodes.name: Explain levers (free)
nodes.notes: This is where lever_token comes from. Without it there is nothing to attest, which is why the five-operation node could not close this loop.

nodes.name: Hold out a control arm
nodes.notes: THE step that makes the evidence worth reading. The acted group is selected by the model's own score, so acted-vs-not differences are observational until you randomise. Seeded on the entity id, never on the score.

nodes.name: Do the play
nodes.notes: Your own action — the call, the discount, the outreach. The engine returns levers and principal reasons; the play is yours.

nodes.name: Attest (free)
nodes.notes: TREATED ARM ONLY. Only a hash of the lever_token is stored, never the token. post_value is the feature's value AFTER you acted.

nodes.name: Report outcome (free)
nodes.notes: BOTH ARMS. Skipping the control arm here is fatal: with no observed outcomes for it there is nothing to compare against. Append-only, and idempotent on event_id, so a retried workflow is safe.

nodes.name: Action evidence (free)
nodes.notes: Expect live: null for a while. 30 reported outcomes per cell before a number exists, small_n below 100.

nodes.name: Drift status (free)
nodes.notes: Only meaningful on a run that passed refit_of. Labels and directions only — react to `recommendation`, never to a coefficient you cannot see. On `abandon` (two consecutive honest-empties) stop working this outcome.
